dialogue.n10_high_court.name: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
dialogue.n10_high_court.root.p1: "Wamkelekile kwiKhomishoni yoPhando, Sbu. I-Berth 14 ivule imfihlo yezibuko, ngoku i-syndicate isilwa nathi ngamagqwetha anxibe iisuti zexabiso kunye nemiyalelo yokuthula evela kuRhulumente."
dialogue.n10_high_court.root.p2: "Okubi nangakumbi, sibambe iinkcukacha zendlela yendiza evela e-King Shaka International. Inqwelo-moya i-ZS-900—i-Gulfstream yabucala—ifakelwe amafutha e-Hangar 7 ukuze ikhuphe uZuko, uMa-Sibi, kunye noMokoena baye e-Dubai."
dialogue.n10_high_court.vdm_act2_briefin: "Imiboniso emibini ebalulekileyo: Okokuqala, i-Sovereign Pearl Offshore Trust Deed evela kwii-penthouse zase-Ridge ebonisa ukuba bobathathu bangabanini be-syndicate. Okwesibini, i-Midlands Super-Lab Batch Telemetry evela kwiitanki zamanzi zaseMantla."
"Vula nayiphi na kwezi ukuze uveze i-Citrus Estate kunye ne-King Shaka Hangar 7—okanye ukhusele zombini ukuba ufuna ukubafaka bonke emaketheni kwitarmac."
dialogue.n10_high_court.vdm_dockets_moti: "Isicatshulwa somthetho esibalaseleyo, Sbu. Oko kubophe izandla zabatshutshisi bakaMa-Sibi abakhohlakeleyo iiyure ezingamashumi amane anesibhozo kwaye kunyanzela unobhala wenkampani yase-Ridge ukuba avule i-ledger ye-DIFC."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.name: Zuko "The Architect" Ndlovu
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.root.p1: "Ulandele iitanki zamanzi kuyo yonke indlela ukuya phezulu entabeni, Sbu. Kuyamangalisa. Uninzi lwamadoda luyayeka xa lufika kwii-penthouse zase-Umhlanga."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.root.p2: "Jonga apha e-Packhouse B. Ii-orenji zase-Valencia kwibhanti yokuhambisa ephezulu, i-crystal ecocekileyo ngamashumi alithoba anesithoba ekhulwini kwiibhokisi zobuxoki ngezantsi, eziya ngqo e-King Shaka Cargo Apron. Kwaye ume phakathi kwesivuno sam."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.zuko_act2_man: "Ndiyoyika? Hayi, Sbu—ndilungisa izinto. I-Khomishoni yoPhando ifuna umboniso, ngoko uMa-Sibi noMokoena bayoyika. Ngeli xesha, iziseko esizakhele apha zishicilela izigidi ezingamashumi amabini e-Euro ngenyanga."
"Xa ufika e-Hangar 7 ngobu busuku, uya kuba nokhetho: usibambe ngenxa yelizwe eliza kusithatha indawo ngoLwesibini, utshise le ndawo neqela likaBra Bheki, okanye uthathe izitshixo zetrone ngokwakho."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.zuko_act2_tru: "Abadubuli base-Gauteng bayayeka. Uzuze indawo etafileni, Sbu. Thatha oku kwiseyfi yase-packhouse—kwaye ucinge nzulu ngaphambi kokuba uvumele uColonel van der Merwe afake amakhamandela kwikamva."
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.mokoena_act2_de: "Umbaleki? Ngamashumi amabini anesihlanu ekhulwini e-Sovereign Pearl Holdings kwivault yase-Dubai, baya kundibiza ngokuba ndingumcebisi wezokhuseleko wamazwe ngamazwe! Nokuba usuke endleleni yevili elingaphambili, okanye wenze umdlalo wakho wokugqibela apha!"
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.mokoena_act2_mu: "Aya phi i-Unit 3 ne-Unit 5?! Sbu, ndikushiyile—ujike amasergeant am ngokuchasene nomda! Wonke umntu uzilwela kwitarmac!"
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.name: Brigadier Titus Mokoena
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.root.p1: "Isiphelo sendlela, Sbu! Iinjini ze-Gulfstream zifudumele, imvume yezopolitiko ifakiwe, kwaye ii-pallet jacks zilayisha iibhokisi zokugqibela kwindawo yokugcina impahla."
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.root.p2: "Usindile kwi-N2, usindile kwi-Pier 2, kwaye usindile kwiqela lam lokubulala. Thetha okwakho ngaphambi kokuba izitepsi zokukhwela zirhoxe!"
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ambush_details.p1: "Izimoto ezimbili ezinamalambu aluhlaza zisivalele ngemva nje kwe-off-ramp yase-Umgeni. UBrigadier Mokoena ubengafakile ngisho imaski. Uphume egqoke izingubo zakhe ze-TRT, wabheka isikhwama sikaSithole, wayala ikorporali yakhe ukuba ishise imoto."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ambush_details.p2: "Ngingene emsele wamanzi ngiphethe ifayela lokuqala ngaphansi kwehembe lami. Uma uSparks e-Golden Dragon engakwazi ukuvula ifoni kaSithole, izwi likaMokoena likhona kuleyo rekhodi."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.dockets_breakthrou: "Bheka—amapuleti ND-449-102 kuya ku-118. Bakhokhise i-City Hall izigidi ezingamashumi amane nambili zamaRandi ukuletha amanzi e-KwaMashu ngesikhathi somlilo, kodwa bheka ama-toll tags. Abazange baye enyakatho."
"Lonke iloli lishayele laqonda e-Pier 2 Cold Storage ngo-01:30 ekuseni. Bathutha amakhemikhali kaZuko Ndlovu ngaphansi kwegama lamanzi kamasipala."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ledger_reaction.p1: "Zululand Aqua-Logistics... amaphesenti angamashumi ayisithupha e-Abasanta Maritime, amaphesenti angamashumi amane e-trust yomndeni ka-Ma-Sibi. Uqinisile, Sbu."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ledger_reaction.p2: "Yisa lokhu ku-Colonel van der Merwe e-Old Archive Basement—noma ushise i-Berth 14 uqobo lwakho. Noma yikuphi, ngeke baphume bengajeziswanga."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.name: Constable Nandi
dialogue.n1_safehouse.root.p1: "Ungavuli amakhethini, Sbu. Ama-Golf GTI ka-Mokoena azungeza i-Anton Lembede Street njalo emizuzwini engamashumi amabili. Ababulalanga nje u-Auditor Sithole e-Umgeni weighbridge—babemlindile, sebesule nazo zonke izimpawu zokulandelela."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.root.p2: "Konke uSithole afela khona kuse-Docket #409 nakuleyo foni ephukile. Ngitshele ukuthi ngeke sifele kuleli fulethi ngobusuku obunje."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.name: Bra Bheki Sithole
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.role: Umphathi Wetekisi e-Queen Street • Umxazululi Wezigebengu
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.root.p1: "Hawu, owayeyiphoyisa le-Hawk ufika e-Queen Street ngesikhathi abafana baka-Mokoena bephenya yonke itekisi e-Warwick Junction. Unesibindi, Sbu, ngiyakuvuma lokho."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.root.p2: "Akukho okuhambayo e-CBD ngaphandle kokuba abashayeli bami bakubone—hhayi ama-Nyalas e-SAPS, futhi ikakhulukazi hhayi lawo maloli amanzi kamasipala asindayo ngabo-2 ekuseni."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.street_favor.p1: "Awukakhohlwa ukuthi umgwaqo usebenza kanjani, Sbu. Kwenziwe. Ama-Quantum ami amathathu avalele imoto yamakhamera e-SAPS e-Monty Naicker Road. Unendawo yokuphefumula."
"Thatha lokhu emalini yempi yomzila. Thenga udizili, nika umabhalane imali, noma usize uNandi alulame. Qiniseka nje ukuthi uMokoena uyopha ngokuminyanisa imigwaqo yethu."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.tanker_rumors.p1: "Lalela kahle. Lawo maloli anezimpawu ze-City Hall eminyango, akunjalo? Kodwa abafana bami abasebenza e-Umbilo bathi amasondo acindezelwe isisindo samakhemikhali, kanti izigebengu zase-Abasanta zihamba ngezimoto i-Golf R."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.tanker_rumors.p2: "Ngesikhathi omama bethu e-KwaMashu belayini namabhakede epulasitiki emapompini omile. U-Councillor Ma-Sibi uthengisa abantu bakubo."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_sha: "Ngoko ke i-Hawk eneenjongo ezintle ekugqibeleni ifunde ixabiso lenyama eThekwini. Thatha le mali ibanjiweyo kwilokhari. Gcina loo fayile yesandi ingafiki edesikeni kaColonel van der Merwe, kwaye mhlawumbi uZuko uya kukuvumela uphile ude ubone iveki ezayo."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_sta: "...Yekani ukusebenza Car 4 kunye ne-Car 7 kwicandelo lase-Victoria Embankment. Ubusoloko usazi ukuba udlalwa njani umdlalo we-bureaucracy, Sbu. Yonwabela ezi yure ezingamashumi amabini anesine—ayiyi kukusindisa xa i-Berth 14 icociwe."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_thr: "IDurban ihamba ngocwangco, Sbu. UZuko ugcina amazibuko ezolile, uMa-Sibi ugcina izibane zivutha eCity Hall, kwaye i-Task Force yam igcina uxolo. UMandla Sithole wayecinga ukuba i-spreadsheet inokumisa uloliwe othwele impahla."
"Nikela uNandi phambi kwentsimbi yeshumi elinesibini ebusuku ngosuku lwesine, kungenjalo amadoda am akayi kuzikhathaza ngokunkqonkqoza emnyango wakho e-Mercury Arcade."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.name: Brigadier Titus Mokoena
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.root.p1: "Hayi bo. Khangela ukuba yintoni le iziswe yimvula apha e-ofisini yam. Uye wamiswa emsebenzini kuma-Hawks, Sbu—ukuhamba ungena apha kufuna ukuba ufuna ukufa okanye unegqwetha elibiza imali eninzi."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.root.p2: "Uphi uConstable Nandi, kwaye iphi ibriefcase yomphicothi-zincwadi kamasipala?"
dialogue.n4_city_hall.dockets_fax.p1: "Abasebenzi abanobuchule abafumaneki kulo masipala. Kulungile—thatha iphepha lokuhanjiswa kweenkqubo zocingo. Uya kufumanisa ukuba likhokelela ngqo kwi-crane kaZuko e-Berth 14."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.grid_admission.p1: "Ukucinywa kombane yintlekele, Sbu—ngaphandle kokuba uyazi ukuba yeyiphi i-breaker omawuyitsale kwaye nini. Xa i-Stage 6 ibetha i-Point Waterfront, iikhamera ezizisebenzelayo ze-Transnet aziboni nto iiyure ezine."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.grid_admission.p2: "Abahlobo be-City Hall abaze bahlale ebumnyameni. Iintshaba zifumana izindlu zazo zihlaselwe phambi kokuba izibane zesitalato zibuye zivuthe."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.ledger_leverage.p1: "UMandla Sithole wayengumphicothi-zincwadi obalaseleyo ongenalo kwaphela ikhono lokusinda. Wena, kwelinye icala, uyaqonda ukuba yintoni i-leverage."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.ledger_leverage.p2: "Nantsi imali engamakhulu amahlanu eRand evela kwingxowa-mali yewadi. Gcina igama letrust yam lingaphumi emaphephandabeni, kwaye i-ofisi yam inokude ilawule umbane we-Eskom xa ufuna ukuba kucinywe izibane."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.name: Councillor "Ma-Sibi" Khumalo
dialogue.n4_city_hall.root.p1: "Vala umnyango, mntwanam, ukufuma konakalisa imahogany. Wonke umntu kwesi sixeko uyakhalaza xa umbane usihla ukuya kwi-Stage 6, kodwa akukho mntu ubuza ukuba ngubani ohlawulela ezopolitiko zekholishini."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.root.p2: "Ubusoloko ujikeleza kwi-Procurement Registry B. Ndixelele ukuba umphengululi ohlaziswe ngolu hlobo ufuna ntoni kwiziseko zophuhliso zamanzi ezingxamisekileyo."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.imsi_sweep.p1: "Ewe, i-Central Precinct ibe ne-stingray tower etshixiweyo kwi-SIM yakho endala. Nditshintshe i-baseband MAC address yakho ukuze ibonakale njengemitha yokupaka kamasipala. Sela!"
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.name: Sparks
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.phone_lore.p1: "USithole wayengenguye nje umphicothi-zincwadi—utyale imakrofoni kwindawo yokugcina izinto ezibandayo e-Pier 2. Phambi kokuba bangqubise imoto yakhe kwi-N2, ifowuni yakhe yagcina umyalezo welizwi wemizuzwana engamashumi amane anesibhozo kunye ne-manifest yezikhongozeli ze-MV Southern Cross."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.phone_lore.p2: "Lumkela ukucinywa kombane kwe-Stage 6, nangona kunjalo. Ngaphandle kokuba usebenzisa i-generator yakho ye-diesel, umatshini wam wokucacisa iikhowudi uyacima."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.root.p1: "Lumka intambo ecaleni kwendawo yokubeka iambrela, Sbu! I-voltage spikes ye-Stage 4 isandula ukutshisa ezimbini kwi-oscilloscopes zam, kwaye amadoda e-cyber-crime kaMokoena ebesoloko ejonga yonke inqaba yomnxeba phakathi kwe-Grey Street kunye nezibuko."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.root.p2: "Uzise i-GraphemeOS brick kaMandla Sithole? Loo fowuni inayo i-Abasanta remote-wipe daemon ehleli kwi-baseband chip."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.wire_collab.p1: "Ayoba! Khangela loo timing ye-voltage—sidlule kwi-lock yokuqala ye-biometric ngaphandle kokubangela i-Abasanta wipe daemon. Enye indlela ecocekileyo ebhentshini kwaye le drive yeyakho."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.name: Zuko "The Architect" Ndlovu
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.root.p1: "Jonga kwisitishi, Sbu. Iinqanawa ezingamashumi amathandathu zilindile, izikhongozeli ezingamawaka amathathu ngemini, kwaye iPretoria icinga ukuba iphepha elisayinwe yimantyi lilawula esi zibuko."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.root.p2: "Ndakhe i-Abasanta Logistics ukusuka kwindawo enye yokugcina izinto ezibandayo. Ngoku umi kwi-catwalk yam unencwadi yomphicothi-zincwadi ofileyo. Uze apha ukuzenza iqhawe, okanye uze apha ukuqonda ukuba yintoni i-supply and demand?"
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_deal.p1: "Indoda ekrelekrele. AmaHawks akuhlawule ngemali encinci aze akujulela kwiingcuka xa usondele kakhulu enyanisweni. Thatha oku njengenzuzo yakho yokuqala evela eBerth 14. Xa kufika phakathi kobusuku, qinisekisa ukuba loo mkhosi uyahamba."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_respect.p1: "Akumangalisi ukuba iqela lababulali bakaMokoena likuphosile kwi-N2. Uhamba njengomsi wezibuko. Xelela uTitus ukuba ndibabizile abalindi bakhe basezibukweni ngobu busuku—ukuba siza kuvavanyana, masikwenze ngaphandle kwabantu abangafundanga endleleni."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_vision.p1: "I-City Hall yeba uhlahlo lwabiwo-mali lwamanzi kwiminyaka elishumi phambi kokuba ndiqeshe itanki, Sbu. Ndivele ndaqesha iilori zabo ezingenanto. Kweli lizwe, iziseko zophuhliso zezomntu ogcina idizili aze ahlawule onogada."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_vision.p2: "UMokoena sisixhobo esingacacanga, kwaye uMa-Sibi yintakazana. Nceda ndicime iBerth 14 ngobu busuku, kwaye awusoze uphinde ukhangele irenti eMercury Arcade."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.name: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.role: DPCI Hawks Holdout • Clean Task Force
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.root.p1: "Ukwazile ukudlula kwiikhamera zenkundla kamantyi, Sbu. Kulungile. Isiqingatha seProvincial Headquarters sikwipeyroli kaMokoena, yiyo loo nto ndisuse iqela lam apha ngezantsi kunye noomatshini be-microfiche bama-1980."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.root.p2: "Ukhangeleka kakubi, mfana wam—kwaye ndivile ukuba uConstable Nandi ufumene imbumbulu kwi-N2. Ndixelele ukuba uzise into enokumelana nomgwebi weNkundla ePhakamileyo."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.vdm_audio_s: "Thixo wam... 'nqanda isedan yakhe phambi kwe-Umgeni off-ramp uze utshise ibriefcase.' Lilo elo ilizwi likaTitus Mokoena, licace gca."
"Ndifaka isithuthi sakho kwirejista yethu yezopolitiko ngoku ukuze ndicime ubushushu bePrecinct yakho. Hlala uphila de sisasaze oku, Sbu."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.vdm_politic: "Ngenxa yokuba ngalo lonke ixesha ndibhala iwaranti phezulu, umntu oseMinistri uxelela i-City Hall kwimizuzu elishumi elinesihlanu. Ngaphandle kwebhuku lezimali KUNYE nesandi saseBerth 14, umtshutshisi uza kuyilahla ityala phambi kwesidlo sakusasa."
"Ukuba sithumela iphakheji epheleleyo ngqo kwigumbi leendaba le-The Daily Veld ngelixa sikhusela amangqina kaNandi, abanakukwazi ukuyifihla."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_act2: "Yithathe. Gxila umsindo wakho kwilabhu kaZuko yaseMidlands okanye kubabulali bakaMokoena—shiya ixhego kwivilla yalo yomhlalaphantsi ePalm Jumeirah."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_duba: "Wonke usopolitiko okumgangatho ophezulu eKwaZulu-Natala uyazi ukuba iRand yeyokuchitha kwaye iDirham yeyokugcina. I-Sovereign Pearl inezindlu eDubai, i-estate yecitrus eMidlands, kunye nenqwelomoya eHangar 7."
"UZuko unamashumi amane anesihlanu ekhulwini, mna ndine-30, kwaye uTitus Mokoena unamashumi amabini anesihlanu ekhulwini ngokugcina imipu ikude nathi."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_swif: "Uqhekeze itheminali ye-escrow? Uyanamathela ngokwenene. Kulungile—abatshutshisi abajongene ne-Contempt Warrant yakho baphendula kum. Ndiza kubaxelela ukuba bacothise ifayile yakho yokubanjwa."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.name: Councillor "Ma-Sibi" Khumalo
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.root.p1: "Umoya ucocekile apha kwi-Ridge, akunjalo, Sbu? Ezantsi kwi-CBD babambe iKomishoni yabo yoPhando, besenza ngathi umgwebi umhlalaphantsi unokulungisa iminyaka engamashumi amabini yoburhwaphilizo."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.root.p2: "Iisutikheyisi zam sele ziseKing Shaka Hangar 7. Kutheni ukhwela inqaba yam yeglasi ngelixa isiphango siphantse saphela?"
dialogue.n9_township_depot.bheki_gps_inf: "Yonke! Phakathi kwe-1:00 AM kunye ne-4:00 AM, endaweni yokumpompa amanzi kwidama, ezi lori zinyuke i-N3 ukuya kwindawo yecitrus kufutshane ne-Howick spur."
"Dibanisa loo datha, Sbu, kwaye uza kuba neendawo ezichanekileyo zelabhu kaZuko."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.bheki_street_: "Nantsi imodyuli evela kwi-Tanker #14! Kwaye ungakhathazeki ngaloo mpu-mhlaba abaqeshwe eJoburg—nasiphi na isedan esingaqhelekanga esingena kwindlela esemantla siza kuvalelwa ngama-Quantum angamashumi amane phambi kokuba balayishe imipu."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.name: Bra Bheki Sithole
dialogue.n9_township_depot.role: Northern Water Strike Marshal • Queen St. Alliance
dialogue.n9_township_depot.root.p1: "Jonga ezi tanki sizibambe ngobu busuku, Sbu! Iibaffles zobuxoki ezidityaniswe ngaphakathi kwimigqomo—zomile njengethambo kwigumbi lamanzi, kwaye kukho intsalela yemichiza kwindawo efihlakeleyo."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.root.p2: "Abantu abakwiindawo ezisemantla badiniwe kukulinda iikomishoni zeNkundla ePhakamileyo. Abaqhubi bam bayivalile i-depot, kwaye izinkabi zikaMokoena ezivela ngaphandle kwesifundazwe zikhangela wena kwiindlela ze-ridge."

dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_exit.label: "Bamba amasango e-depot, Bra Bheki. Siza kuhlasela i-estate yabo."
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_gps.label: "Ngaba iitanki ezibanjiweyo zisenawo ama-transponder e-GPS kwiidashbodi zawo?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_street.label: [STREET >= 2] "Masikhupha iitshiphu ze-GPS kwi-Lead Tanker #14 ngoku kwaye simise abantu abajongayo ngokuchasene neqela lababulali."
dialogue_resp.bheki_ask_tankers.label: "Abashayeli bakho basebusuku bathini ngamaloli amanzi kamasipala?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_back.label: "Ulwazi oluhle. Masikhulume ngokunye."
dialogue_resp.bheki_exit.label: "Gcina izibani zakho ziphansi, Bra Bheki."
dialogue_resp.bheki_favor_back.label: "Inhlonipho, Bra Bheki."
dialogue_resp.bheki_gps_back.label: "Lelo khonkco elilahlekileyo phakathi kwezibuko kunye nesikhululo seenqwelomoya."
dialogue_resp.bheki_rally_back.label: "Amandla, Bra Bheki."
dialogue_resp.bheki_rep_stipend.label: [Street Syndicate Rep >= 2] "Ubumbano lwase-Queen Street luyema. Ingabe itekisi ingangisiza ngemali yokusebenza?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_stipend_back.label: "Izoya ngqo ekubhidlizeni umkhumbi wabo."
dialogue_resp.bheki_street_check.label: [STREET >= 2] "Abashayeli bakho bangikweleta ngenxa yokuthula komzila wase-Berea. Susa amapuleti ami kubahloli baka-Mokoena."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_back.label: "Ukwahlula okucacileyo."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_deed.label: [Bonisa Ubungqina: Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed] "Ndinoluhlu lobunini, Ma-Sibi. Thenga indawo yakho kwi-charge sheet yam."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_exit.label: "Musa ukukhwela loo Gulfstream okwangoku, Councillor."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_trust.label: "Yintoni iSovereign Pearl Holdings, kwaye kutheni iGulfstream iphethroli eHangar 7?"
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_wire.label: [WIRE >= 2] "Umncedisi wakho wezimali ulibele ukucima isipili se-Dubai SWIFT kwiseva yomgangatho wama-28."
dialogue_resp.masibi_ask_grid.label: "Kutheni i-Sub-Station 14 ihlala icima xa i-Pier 2 ithoba impahla phakathi kobusuku?"
dialogue_resp.masibi_dockets_check.label: [DOCKETS >= 2] "Umncedisi wakho ushiye ishedyuli yokucima i-Sub-Station 14 kumatshini wefeksi. Ndikopa iwindow yokucima umbane kwizibuko."
dialogue_resp.masibi_exit.label: "Yonwabela i-air-conditioning ngelixa isekhona, Councillor."
dialogue_resp.masibi_fax_back.label: "Enkosi kakhulu, Councillor."
dialogue_resp.masibi_grid_back.label: "Isivumelwano esilungelelanisiweyo."
dialogue_resp.masibi_leverage_back.label: "Ndiza kuyifaka epokothweni imali. Siza kubona ngamaphephandaba."
dialogue_resp.masibi_payoff_back.label: "Siza kubona ukuba ngubani oza kuhamba ngenqwelomoya."
dialogue_resp.masibi_present_ledger.labe: [Present Evidence: Decoded Water-Tanker Ledger] "Amashumi amane ekhulwini e-Zululand Aqua-Logistics ngawetrust yosapho lwakho, Ma-Sibi."
dialogue_resp.masibi_swift_back.label: "Inyathelo elikrelekrele."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_act2_exit.label: "Lixesha lokugqiba oku kwitarmac."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_act2_influence.lab: [INFLUENCE >= 2] "Isiqingatha samasergeant akho e-TRT asikho kule nqwelo-moya, Titus. Ndibaxelele nje ukuba ubashiya ukuze bathwale ityala kwiKhomishoni."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_act2_tarmac.label: "Ukuba unyuka ezo zitepsi, Titus, uya kuba ngumbaleki ubomi bakho bonke."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_bluff.label: "Ndijonga nje uluhlu lwamatyala olusesidlangalaleni, Brigadier. Ingaba ukhathazekile ngento ethile kwi-N2?"
dialogue_resp.mokoena_exit.label: "Ubusuku obuhle, Brigadier. Lumka xa kucinywe izibane."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_influence_check.la: [INFLUENCE >= 2] "I-Internal Affairs yasePretoria sele inekopi ye-Docket #409. Yeka ukukhangela okanye sonke siza kutsha."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_mutiny_back.label: "Itarmac ivulekile. Masikugqibe oku."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_present_manifest.l: [Present Evidence: Berth 14 Manifest] "Ndine-tape yelizwi lakho ualela ukubulawa komntu e-Umgeni, Titus. Ndihlawule ukuze ndiyilahle le kopi."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_shakedown_back.lab: "Siza kubona ukuba ikhredithi yakho ihlala ixesha elingakanani."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_threat_back.label: "Yigcine loo nto engqondweni, Titus."
dialogue_resp.nandi_ask_ambush.label: "Ngichazele futhi ngokuhlaselwa e-N2 weighbridge. Ubani odonse isibhamu?"
dialogue_resp.nandi_back_root.label: "Masibuyele ezindleleni zethu."
dialogue_resp.nandi_dockets_back.label: "Lokho kungisindisa amahora okuhlola izincwadi. Bamba kancane."
dialogue_resp.nandi_dockets_check.label: [DOCKETS >= 2] "Bheka lezi zikhathi ze-weighbridge nami. Yimaphi amapuleti amaloli abefihliwe?"
dialogue_resp.nandi_exit.label: "Phumula, Nandi. Valisisa umnyango ngesikhathi ngisebenza emgwaqweni."
dialogue_resp.nandi_leave_ambush.label: "Ngiyaqinisekisa ukuthi leyo rekhodi iyaphuma."
dialogue_resp.nandi_ledger_back.label: "Ungazikhandi. Sesingena esigabeni sokugcina."
dialogue_resp.nandi_show_ledger.label: [Veza Ubufakazi: Incwadi Yezimali Yamaloli Amanzi] "Ngilandele inkampani eyimfihlo. U-Ma-Sibi noZuko bangabanikazi balamaloli."
dialogue_resp.sparks_ask_phone.label: "Yintoni ekule fowuni yomphicothi-zincwadi eyenza uZuko noMokoena boyike kangaka?"
dialogue_resp.sparks_coffee_stim.label: [Pay R100] "Beka imbiza ye-espresso yase-Ethiopia kwigesi kwaye ukhangele i-SAPS IMSI-catchers kwifowuni yam."
dialogue_resp.sparks_collab_back.label: "Ukudibanisa okuhle, Sparks."
dialogue_resp.sparks_exit.label: "Gcina i-Faraday cage ivaliwe, Sparks."
dialogue_resp.sparks_imsi_back.label: "Loo nto iyandichulumancisa."
dialogue_resp.sparks_lore_back.label: "Kulungile ukwazi. Masijonge ibhentshi."
dialogue_resp.sparks_wire_check.label: [WIRE >= 2] "Masidibanise i-JTAG pins ngaphakathi kwi-Faraday cage phambi kokuba i-baseband iqhagamshelane nenqaba."
dialogue_resp.vdm_act2_dockets.label: [DOCKETS >= 2] "Masifake isicelo esingxamisekileyo ngoku ukuze sichithe i-Contempt Warrant kwaye sibize iirekhodi ze-escrow zase-Ridge."
dialogue_resp.vdm_act2_exit.label: "Gcina iKhomishoni iqhuba, Colonel. Ndiyazingela."

ending.ending_act2_reckoning.hook: IPHULO LIGQITYIWE (ISIQEPHU 1 + ISIQEPHU 2): Usindile ekucimeni kombane, wazityhila iimfihlo zeSovereign Pearl, kwaye wazisa abangachukunyiswayo base-eThekwini-Gold phambi kwesiko.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p1: As Gulfstream ZS-900 turns onto the active taxiway, four unmarked Hawks interceptors and a High Court sheriff’s van block the nose gear. You step out into the blinding sodium glare holding the certified Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed and the Midlands super-lab batch logs.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p2: Brigadier Mokoena reaches for his holster, but seeing twenty DPCI rifles trained on the airstairs—and a live broadcast camera streaming directly to the Commission’s emergency feed—he slowly lowers his weapon. Councillor Ma-Sibi and Zuko Ndlovu are led down the wet stairs in steel cuffs.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p3: By morning, the KwaZulu-Natal High Court places Zululand Aqua-Logistics under judicial administration, and the northern township reservoirs open to full pressure for the first time in a year.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.quote: "Okokuqala ngqa kwiminyaka engamashumi amabini, iisireni eziluhlaza bezingacoci indlela yee-VIP—bezibabamba ngeziqhushumbisi."
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.shift1.summ: Zuko Ndlovu, Councillor Ma-Sibi, and Brigadier Mokoena face 142 counts of racketeering, treasonous sabotage, and murder before a special High Court tribunal.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.shift2.summ: Forensic teams seize R1.2 billion in offshore escrow and dismantle the Howick hydroponic precursor plant.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.shift3.summ: Promoted to Major in the rebuilt DPCI Organised Crime Directorate, you and Constable Nandi take over the 13th Floor of Central Isikhululo Samapolisa.

ending.ending_act2_revolution.hook: IPHULO LIGQITYIWE (ISIQEPHU 1 + ISIQEPHU 2): Uqhekeze i-syndicate yorhwaphilizo kurhulumente kwaye wabuyisela ubomi base-eThekwini-Gold ebantwini.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.p1: Instead of waiting for slow court orders, you broadcast the Hangar 7 coordinates and the Sovereign Pearl escrow keys directly to Bra Bheki’s Queen Street marshals and the Northern Township strike committees.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.p2: Within thirty minutes, three hundred minibus taxis and forty hijacked municipal water tankers smash through the cargo apron perimeter fence, surrounding Gulfstream ZS-900 on the runway. Zuko’s mercenaries drop their rifles and flee into the sugarcane fields.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.p3: Before sunrise, the Iqumrhu Lolwaphulo-mthetho’s R400 million liquid escrow is wired directly into community water cooperatives, and a convoy of freshly flushed tankers rolls into KwaMashu with sirens blaring in celebration.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.quote: "Bebale amanzi baze basithengisela imbalela. Ngobu busuku sibuyisele iilori, iitephu, kunye neakhawunti yebhanki."
ending.ending_act2_revolution.shift1.sum: The Northern Township Water Forum seizes permanent control of the municipal tanker fleet, ending the artificial drought overnight.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.shift2.sum: Stripped of both their Iqela Lolwaphulo-mthetho protection and offshore slush funds, Ma-Sibi’s coalition resigns en masse amid citywide street celebrations.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.shift3.sum: Every minibus from Point Road to the Midlands carries your callsign on the rear window—the outlaw Hawk who gave the city back to its streets.

ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.hook: IPHULO LIGQITYIWE (ISIQEPHU 1 + ISIQEPHU 2): Uboyise bonke abachasi e-eThekwini-Gold kwaye wabanga itrone yombuso wethunzi.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p1: You stand alone in the rain at Hangar 7 with your thumb on the encrypted broadcast switch. Zuko Ndlovu looks at the High Court subpoena in your left hand and the Dubai flight plan in your right, then smiles and signs the transfer of Sovereign Pearl Holdings.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p2: At 00:05 AM, you call off the Hawks interceptors and watch Gulfstream ZS-900 climb into the storm clouds toward the Indian Ocean. Ten minutes later, Colonel van der Merwe receives a sanitized Idokethi pinning the entire conspiracy on a dead deputy clerk.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p3: From the top floor of the Umhlanga Ridge glass tower, you watch Stage 6 plunge the city below into darkness—while your private turbines hum without a flicker.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.quote: "Imibuso ayiwi xa ukumkani ekhwela inqwelo-moya. Batshintsha nje iisignitsha kwididi yothemba."
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.shift: With Zuko, Ma-Sibi, and Mokoena exiled in Dubai, you assume 100% control of Sovereign Pearl Holdings, the Izibuko cranes, and the Midlands estate.
The State Capture Inquiry releases a toothless 900-page report recommending "administrative reforms" with zero high-profile convictions.
You own the judges, the taxi ranks, and the municipal tenders. In eThekwini-Gold, midnight now belongs to you.

ending.ending_act2_vanished.p1: Arriving at Hangar 7 without certified proof of either the Sovereign Pearl trust or the Midlands batch telemetry leaves you exposed on the open tarmac. When Stage 6 cuts the airport perimeter lights, Brigadier Mokoena’s sniper team pins your vehicle behind a cargo loader.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.p2: Gulfstream ZS-900 roars down the runway and lifts into the coastal clouds carrying every original Incwadi Yezemali and witness out of South African jurisdiction.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.p3: Three weeks later, the Commission of Inquiry closes its proceedings behind locked doors, sealing your uncorroborated testimony in the National Archives for fifty years.

ending.ending_captured.p1: Exhausted, broke, and boxed in by Operation Shanela roadblocks, your trail finally runs out in the rain-swept alleys behind Queen Street. When the grid drops to Stage 6, the streetlights die—and four unmarked TRT Volkswagen Golfs box you against the shuttered roller doors.
ending.ending_captured.p2: Brigadier Mokoena doesn’t read you your rights. He pulls Idokethi #409 and the dead auditor’s phone from your coat pocket, checks the seal, and nods to Sergeant Dlamini.
ending.ending_captured.p3: By the time the morning commuters crowd the taxi rank, theMercury Arcade flat has been scrubbed Kuhle, and another anonymous dossier has vanished into the furnace of eThekwini-Gold.

ending.ending_kingpin.p1: The private elevator to The Glass House rises above the rusted container cranes into air-conditioned silence. Zuko Ndlovu pours two glasses of single malt while Brigadier Mokoena and Councillor Ma-Sibi’s Chief of Staff watch you lay the bloodstained original pages of Idokethi #409 and the auditor’s decrypted drive onto the glass table.
ending.ending_kingpin.p2: "Logistics is about removing friction," Zuko says softly, looking out over the darkened city grid. "You proved more capable than Brigadier Mokoena’s entire regiment. Name your tariff."
ending.ending_kingpin.p3: You strike the match yourself. As the original forensic annexures curl into ash, your suspension is wiped from the SAPS mainframe, Constable Nandi’s name is cleared with a quiet medical pension, and your newly registered consulting firm is awarded 20% of the Zululand Aqua-Logistics pipeline.

ending.ending_vigilante.p1: When Stage 6 kills the Izibuko floodlights at midnight, Bra Bheki’s minibus convoy cuts its headlights and blocks the Pier 2 weighbridge. Fifteen heavily armed izinkabi step out from behind the rusting container stacks just as Brigadier Mokoena’s unmarked TRT vans escort the municipal water tankers onto Berth 14.
ending.ending_vigilante.p2: The firefight echoes across the Natal Port Channel for twenty minutes. Punctured chemical drums spill across the wet asphalt, catching a tracer round and sending a wall of orange flame forty metres into the humid night sky.
ending.ending_vigilante.p3: In the chaos, you breach the lead armoured command van, haul out two steel cases of Abasanta bearer Imali Eyinkemba, and pull Constable Nandi into your getaway car before the port sirens even spin up.

ending.ending_whistleblower.p1: At 04:00 AM, Colonel Piet van der Merwe’s loyal Hawks task force seals the steel blast doors of the Old Uvimba Igumbi Elingaphantsi. While Constable Nandi is smuggled onto a light aircraft bound for a witness-protection safe farm in the Drakensberg, you upload the decrypted Berth 14 audio and the audited Zululand Aqua-Logistics ledgers to every independent newsroom in the country.
ending.ending_whistleblower.p2: By sunrise, Brigadier Mokoena’s voice—ordering the execution of the municipal auditor and clearing the N2 weighbridge for Zuko’s chemical tankers—is playing on every taxi radio and morning news bulletin from Durban to Johannesburg.
ending.ending_whistleblower.p3: Outside City Hall, thousands of residents whose taps have been dry for months flood the streets, surrounding Councillor Ma-Sibi’s motorcade.

event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.p2: Ezantsi kwezitepsi ze-airstairs kumi abayili abathathu bokubanjwa kwe-eThekwini-Gold: u-Zuko Ndlovu kwidyasi yakhe ecocekileyo, u-Councillor Ma-Sibi ephethe ipasipoti yakhe yediplomasi, kunye no-Brigadier Mokoena enesibhamu sakhe esijoliswe kwi-tarmac emanzi.
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.p3: "Imizuzu emihlanu phambi kokuba sihambe, Warrant Officer," utsho u-Zuko ngaphezu kwengxolo ye-jet. "Zigqibele ukuba luhlobo luni lwelizwe oza kuvuka kulo ngomso."
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.speaker: Zuko Ndlovu, Cllr. Ma-Sibi & Brig. Mokoena
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.title: Ukuhamba e-Hangar 7: Isigwebo sokugqibela
event.evt_act2_contempt_arrest.p1: Amapolisa axhobileyo kunye neearhente zoKhuseleko loRhulumente bakungqongile kumanyathelo eNkundla ePhakamileyo, bephakamise umyalelo wokuvalelwa otywinwe phantsi koMthetho woKhuseleko loLwazi loRhulumente.
event.evt_act2_contempt_arrest.p2: "Uvalelwe ngokusemthethweni ngenxa yokufunyanwa uneerekhodi ezingekho mthethweni zeziseko zophuhliso zikamasipala."
event.evt_act2_contempt_arrest.speaker: Advocate Vermeulen
event.evt_act2_contempt_arrest.title: Iwaranti yokuGatywa koKhuseleko loRhulumente
event.evt_act2_izinkabi_ambush.location: Umhlanga M4 Highway Overpass • Phakathi kobusuku
event.evt_act2_izinkabi_ambush.p1: Iibakkie ezimbini ezimhlophe ezineekhabhathi ezimbini ezivela ngaphandle zivalela isedan yakho eludongeni lwekhonkrithi kwi-M4 coastal flyover. Ukudubula kukhanyisa imvula njengoko iimbumbulu zompu ozenzekelayo zikrazula ifestile yakho yangaphambili.
event.evt_act2_izinkabi_ambush.p2: UZuko kunye noBrigadier Mokoena basebenzise ababulali babo abaqeshiweyo abavela ngaphandle kwesixeko ukuze baqinisekise ukuba awufiki kwitafile yobungqina kwiNkundla ePhakamileyo.
event.evt_act2_izinkabi_ambush.speaker: Izinkabi ezingaphandle kwesixeko
event.evt_act2_izinkabi_ambush.title: Ukudubulana kwi-M4 Flyover
event.evt_act2_lab_telemetry.p1: I-GPS ka-Sparks idityaniswe ngokucacileyo kwimephu yezolimo yesiphondo. Zonke iitanki zamanzi zikamasipala ezibhalelwe iilokishi ezomileyo zaseMantla ziqhutyelwe ngasese kwi-N3 highway ukuya e-Lot 44: i-Hydroponic Citrus Estate.
event.evt_act2_lab_telemetry.p2: Okungcono nangakumbi, i-manifest yempahla ibonisa ukuba iitoni ezi-1.8 ze-crystal ezigqityiweyo zilayishwe kwiipalethi zeziqhamo ezithunyelwa e-Hangar 7 kwi-King Shaka International Airport ngobu busuku.
event.evt_act2_lab_telemetry.speaker: Bra Bheki Sithole
event.evt_act2_lab_telemetry.title: Impumelelo: I-Telemetry yase-Midlands Packhouse
event.evt_act2_morning_commission_leak.p: Amaphephandaba ase-KwaZulu-Natal apapasha iintloko zeendaba ezivela kwiKhomishoni yoPhando. E-Umhlanga Ridge, oomatshini bokutshabalalisa amaphepha basebenza ngokugqithisileyo ngelixa abalawuli beenkampani zephepha bebalekela ukubhukisha iinqwelomoya e-King Shaka.
event.evt_act2_trust_unmasked.location: I-Vault yobungqina beNkundla ePhakamileyo • Encrypted Uplink
event.evt_act2_trust_unmasked.p1: Umatshini wokushicilela kwigumbi elivaliweyo lika-Colonel van der Merwe uyaqala ukusebenza, ukhupha irejista yabanini be-DIFC Dubai ye-Sovereign Pearl Holdings.
event.evt_act2_trust_unmasked.p2: Nantsi imnyama namhlophe: Zuko Ndlovu (45%), Councillor Ma-Sibi (30%), kunye noBrigadier Titus Mokoena (25%)—kunye ne-charter ehlawulelweyo ye-Gulfstream G550 (Flight ZS-900) elindele e-King Shaka Hangar 7 kunye neetayitile zomhlaba ze-Lot 44 eMidlands.
event.evt_act2_trust_unmasked.speaker: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
event.evt_act2_trust_unmasked.title: Impumelelo: I-Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed
event.evt_climax_berth14.p1: Imvula iyana ecaleni kwe-Natal Port Channel njengoko i-cranes ezinkulu zase-Pier 2 zivela enkungwini. Ngaphantsi kwe-Berth 14, iitanki zamanzi ezintathu zilindile ecaleni kwe-containers zikaZuko Ndlovu, zikhaphelwa zi-Nyalas ze-TRT zikaBrigadier Mokoena.
event.evt_climax_berth14.p2: Ixesha lakho liphelile. Nokuba ufike apha neerekhodi zemali, i-voice notes, okanye amandla, unethuba elinye lokudlala ikhadi lakho ngaphambi kokuba i-convoy iphume iye kwi-N2 highway.
event.evt_climax_berth14.speaker: Port Control & Tactical Dispatch
event.evt_climax_berth14.title: Midnight at Berth 14: The Final Play
event.evt_composure_breakdown.p1: Izandla zakho aziyeki ukungcangcazela. Phakathi kwemisizi ye-diesel, ukukhala kweesireni e-Queen Street, kunye neenyanga ezintandathu uzijongile, umbono wakho uba mnyama.
event.evt_composure_breakdown.p2: Uwa kwizitepsi zekonkrithi ezimanzi ze-Mercury Arcade, uzama ukuphefumla. Ukuba awuzolanga ngoku, uza kwenza impazamo ebulalayo.
event.evt_composure_breakdown.speaker: Ingcinga zangaphakathi
event.evt_composure_breakdown.title: Ubumnyama obunokwenzeka: Ukuwa kwemithambo-luvo
event.evt_docket_decoded.p1: Ubeka amaphepha anegazi e-Docket #409 phezu kwetafile yakho phantsi kwesibane. Amanani ekugqibeleni ayangqinelana.
event.evt_docket_decoded.p2: "Zululand Aqua-Logistics" ihlawulise i-City Hall i-R400 million ukuhambisa amanzi kwiilokishi ezomileyo ezisemantla. Kodwa i-GPS ibonisa ukuba ezo tanki azizange ziye ezilokishini—ziqhube zaya ngqo ukusuka e-Pier 2 Cold Storage ukuya kwiindawo zokugcina iimpahla ngaphandle kwedolophu, zikhaphelwa ziiveni ze-TRT zikaBrigadier Mokoena.
event.evt_docket_decoded.p3: UCEba Ma-Sibi akabi nje imali yamanzi. Iitanki zakhe zithutha iikhemikhali zokwenza i-methamphetamine kwi-super-labs kaZuko Ndlovu.
event.evt_docket_decoded.title: The Water-Tanker Pipeline
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.location: West Street & Umgeni Corridor • Cycle 3 Dawn
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.p1: Umsi omnyama ongqindilili unyuka usuka kwisikhululo sase-Umgeni ngesifingo. I-syndicate yokuqweqwedisa ubhedu iqweqwedise iintambo ezintathu zombane eziphezulu ngobusuku, nto leyo eyenze ukuba izibane zendlela ze-CBD zibe sesiphithiphithini.
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.p2: Abaphathi bendlela bakaBra Bheki bathathe iimpambano zeendlela ngemimpempe kunye nezitshamboko, ngelixa iiveni zamapolisa ze-SAPS zixakeke zivaleleke kwizibini zezitalato kude.
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.speaker: Bra Bheki Sithole
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.title: Dispatch yakusasa: Umgeni Feeder Cable Stripped
event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.p1: Njengoko iiteksi zakusasa ziqala ukukhala e-Queen Street, ifowuni yakho encinci iyagungqa ngomyalezo we-Signal ongabhalwanga ovela kumgangatho wesi-4 we-City Hall.
event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.p2: "Warrant Officer. Siyazi ukuba uConstable Nandi uzise amaphepha kaMandla Sithole kuwe. Akukho mntu e-City Hall ufuna omnye umngcwabo. Cothisa uphicotho-zincwadi lwakho namhlanje, kwaye i-R800 yentlawulo yocwangciso kamasipala iza kufakwa ebhokisini yakho yeleta kwiyure leyo."
event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.speaker: INtloko yabasebenzi bakaCouncillor Ma-Sibi
event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.title: Ucingo olufihliweyo: Isebe lomnquma lomgangatho wesi-4
event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.p1: Iphondo liyakhala kumanzi echweba njengoko inqanawa i-MV Southern Cross idlula kwindawo yokukhusela amaza. Unomathotholo wakho ofihlakeleyo uqala ukukhupha ingxolo ngelizwi lika-Colonel van der Merwe.
event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.p2: "Phulaphula kakuhle. Iigubu zeekhemikhali zikaZuko Ndlovu zithotywa eBerth 14 ngobu busuku, kwaye iiveni ze-TRT zikaMokoena sele zimi kwindawo yokulinganisa. Qinisekisa ukuba uphethe i-Decoded Tanker Ledger okanye i-Berth 14 Manifest phambi kokuba ibe phakathi kobusuku."
event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.speaker: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.title: Umyalezo Ongxamisekileyo: MV Southern Cross IseBerth 14
event.evt_nandi_critical.location: Mercury Arcade Flat • Igumbi lokulala lase-Safehouse
event.evt_nandi_critical.p1: UNandi uyangcangcazela phantsi kwengubo emanzi te. Inxeba lembumbulu ecaleni kwembambo zakhe lijike laba mnyama, kwaye uyaquleka aphinde aphaphame.
event.evt_nandi_critical.p2: Ukuba umusa e-Addington okanye e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Hospital, irejista yezibhamu iya kwazisa uBrigadier Mokoena kwimizuzu engamashumi amabini.
event.evt_nandi_critical.speaker: Constable Nandi
event.evt_nandi_critical.title: Septic Shock
event.evt_phone_decrypted.p1: U-Sparks ukhupha umsi we-vape njengoko ifowuni yomphicothi-zincwadi ofileyo ivuleka. Ngaphakathi kwifolda efihlakeleyo kukho irekhodi yesandi kunye ne-manifest yezinto eziza kuthunyelwa ngobu busuku.
event.evt_phone_decrypted.p2: Kwi-recording, ilizwi likaBrigadier Mokoena alithandabuzeki: "Cacisani i-N2 weighbridge phakathi kobusuku. I-container kaZuko iza kwehla e-Berth 14, kwaye nabani na ovela kwi-Hawks oza kuzama ukujonga uya kungcwatywa emgodini."
event.evt_phone_decrypted.speaker: Sparks
event.evt_phone_decrypted.title: Voice Note from Berth 14
event.evt_shanela_roadblock.p1: Izikhalo ze-siren zivakala phakathi kwezakhiwo eziphakamileyo. Izibane ezikhanyisa kakhulu kunye neekhoni ezio-orenji zivala iindlela eziphambili ze-CBD njengoko i-SAPS kunye ne-Metro Police besenza umgca wokukhangela abantu.
event.evt_shanela_roadblock.p2: Yonke iteksi, ibhayisekile yezithunywa, kunye nabahambi ngeenyawo bakhangelwa izixhobo ezingekho mthethweni kunye neefayile ezibiweyo.
event.evt_shanela_roadblock.speaker: Metro Police Dispatch
event.evt_shanela_roadblock.title: Operation Shanela Lockdown
event.evt_trt_safehouse_raid.p1: Iibhoti zomkhosi zikhala ngamandla kwizitepsi zekonkrithi ze-Mercury Arcade. Ngaphandle kwiimfama, i-Volkswagen Golf GTI ezintathu ezingabhalwanga kunye ne-Nyala armoured carrier zivala zombini iziphelo zesitalato.
event.evt_trt_safehouse_raid.p2: Isiphelo sompu sikhala kwi-gate yakho yentsimbi. "Hawks Warrant Officer! Vula isango okanye siza kuqhekeza iihingi! U-Brigadier Mokoena ufuna idocket yakhe!"
event.evt_trt_safehouse_raid.speaker: Sergeant Dlamini
event.evt_trt_safehouse_raid.title: Izibane eziluhlaza kwindlela emxinwa

intro.no_active_dossier_desc: Vula ifayile entsha yophando ukuze ukhethe imvelaphi yakho yomcuphi kwaye uqalise i-Cycle 1 e-eThekwini-Gold.
intro.pitch: Kwiinyanga ezintandathu ezidlulileyo, uBrigadier Titus Mokoena wakumangalela ngobuxoki waza wangcwaba ibheji yakho yee-Hawks. Ngobu busuku, ngexesha lokucinywa kombane kwe-Stage 4 elunxwemeni, lowo wayesakuba liqabane lakho elitsha ungena kwiflethi yakho yase-Mercury Arcade esopha ngenxa yenxeba lompu—ephethe irejista enegazi edibanisa iithenda zamanzi zeDolophu ze-R400m ngqo ne-cartel yeziyobisi yase-Abasanta.
intro.pitch_story2: Ukutshatyalaliswa kobuchule bokuveliswa kombane e-Eskom ukunyanzelisa iithenda zikadizili zikaxakeka, ezixhaswa ngoonongxowankulu bezokhuseleko nabaphathiswa abakhohlakeleyo. Umphandi we-SIU uKagiso "Bra K" Molefe kufuneka angene kwimingxuma enzulu yaseGoli nakwizindlu zaseSandton phambi kokuba uthungelwano luwe.
intro.pitch_story3: Iimvume ezingabhaliswanga zokombiwa kwedayimane phantsi kolwandle, ukuthunyelwa kwezixhobo ezinqumla imida, kunye namajoni olwandle abucala ahlamba imali yamandla kumatye eembambano zamazwe ngamazwe kunxweme lwe-Atlantic olunesiphango e-Port Nolloth nase-Richtersveld.
intro.pitch_story4: Umdibaniso ofihlakeleyo weejeneyali zamapolisa zephondo, imibutho yamagela e-Cape Flats emanyeneyo, kunye noonongxowankulu bembali base-Winelands abaxhoba umkhosi wokhuseleko wabucala ukulawula uqoqosho lwasebusuku kunye namazibuko othumelo. Owayesakuba ngumcuphi we-Anti-Gang Unit u-Leila Hendricks uphanda ukusuka e-Camps Bay ukuya kwiindawo zewayini zase-Stellenbosch.
intro.pitch_story5: Ukuwa Okupheleleyo Kwethungelwano Lombane Lwe-Stage 8 Kuwo Onke Amaphondo Asithoba. Iqela Elihlanganisiweyo Le-Hawks limanyanisa amadokhumenti amane abalulekileyo ommandla ukuhlasela ingqungquthela ye-Sovereign Octagon e-Drakensberg phambi kokuba idemokhrasi ichithwe unaphakade.

mission.faq_q1_body: I-Cycle lusuku olu-1 emdlalweni (ishifti yeeyure ezingama-24). Akukho siphelo simiselweyo esifana neentsuku ezingama-50 okanye ezili-100. Kunoko, ubaleka ngokuchasene NeeWotshi zoSongo eziQhubekayo (njengokuhlasela kuka-Brigadier Mokoena kumacandelo ama-6). Uphando oluqhelekileyo luthatha iijikelezo ezi-3 ukuya kwezi-6 ze-Act 1 kunye nezi-4 ukuya kwezi-8 ze-Act 2.
mission.faq_q2_body: Qho kusasa, uphosa amadayisi ama-3 ukuya kwama-5 EWONKE kwisixeko sonke ngokusekelwe kwi-Composure yakho (80%+ = amadayisi ama-5, 40–79% = amadayisi ama-4, <40% = amadayisi ama-3). AWUWAYI amadayisi kuyo yonke indawo! Ukhetha izenzo eziphambili ezi-3 ukuya kwezi-5 kwimephu ukuze utyale umgudu wakho wemihla ngemihla.
mission.faq_q2_title: 2. Ndifumana amadayisi amangaphi? Ngaba ndiphosa amadayisi kuyo yonke indawo?
mission.faq_q3_body:
Ukucofa u-Phelisa i-Cycle kuphetha ishifti yakho kwaye kuqhubela phambili kwintsasa elandelayo:
• Iiwotshi zoSongo ziyahambela phambili (+1 icandelo kwiiwotshi ezibomvu).
• Ucinyo lombane luyajikeleza (Stage 2 → 4 → 6 → 2).
• Ucingo oluFihliweyo lwaseKusasa luyafika luneenkcukacha ezintsha zebali.
• Uphosa idayisi entsha ngomso kusasa.
mission.faq_q3_title: 3. Kwenzeka ntoni xa ndicofa "Phelisa i-Cycle / Lala"?
mission.faq_q4_body: I-tray esezantsi ibonisa "X eKhoyo • Y eSetyenzisiweyo". Amadayisi asetyenzisiweyo ajika abe ngwevu emnyama kwaye abonise i-tag ye-[ESETYENZISIWEYO]. Amadayisi akhoyo ngamabhloko aqaqambileyo anamaqhosha egolide okanye amanani.
mission.faq_q4_title: 4. Ndazi njani ukuba ngawaphi amadayisi asetyenzisiweyo kunye nawo akhoyo?
mission.faq_q5_body: Ewe! Ukuba ukuhlasela kuka-Brigadier Mokoena kufikelela ku-6/6, iflethi yakho iyahlaselwa kwaye uphando luphelela ekubanjweni. Ukuba ukopha kuka-Constable Nandi kubetha u-4/4 phambi kokuba umzinzise, ufa ngokusisigxina kwiflethi yakho (-30% Composure). Ukuba i-Composure yakho ibetha u-0%, uqalisa i-Blackout Paranoia!
mission.faq_q5_title: 5. Ngaba umlinganiswa wam angafa okanye aqalise i-Game Over?
mission.how_to_win_act1: Chaza Docket #409 (kwiflethi yase-Mercury Arcade) okanye uqhekeze i-Auditor's Handset (e-Golden Dragon). Xa uphethe nayiphi na into, i-Pier 2 kunye ne-Old Archive ziyavuleka, zikuvumela ukuba uqalise i-Berth 14 Finale kwaye udlulele ku-Act 2!
mission.how_to_win_act2: Fumana i-Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed (kwiNkundla ePhakamileyo) okanye i-Super-Lab Telemetry (e-Township Depot). Xa sele ufumene, i-King Shaka Cargo Apron kunye ne-Citrus Estate zivulekile. Qala i-Hangar 7 Finale ukukhetha ikamva lakho lokugqibela (Ukuphenduliswa, Imvukelo, Urhulumente we-Syndicate, okanye Ukunyamalala).

pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p1: Ngeentsimbi ezimbini kusasa, umbane kamasipala ucima ngesandi esinzima sesinyithi esivela kwisikhululo esisezantsi e-Queen Street. Ifeni yophahla iyacotha ide ime. Ngaphandle kweefestile zakho, imvula efumileyo yaselunxwemeni ibetha uphahla lwe-zinc lwe-Mercury Arcade, ekhanyiswe kuphela kukukhanya okutyheli kwejeneretha yedizili yestolo esikufuphi.
pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p2: Edesikeni yakho kukho ibhotile yotywala bomoba esele iphantse yaphela kunye neleta yokumiswa emsebenzini etyikitywe nguBrigadier Titus Mokoena kwiinyanga ezintandathu ezidlulileyo.
pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p3: Emva koko kuza isandi—hayi kwintsimbi yomnyango osezantsi, kodwa kukubetha okuthathu okukhawulezayo nokumanzi kwisango lakho lentsimbi i-Trellidor phezulu kwizinyuko zomlilo. Phambi kokuba ufikelele kwi-9mm Parabellum phantsi kukamatrasi wakho, khumbula ukuba ungubani ngaphambi kokuba uMokoena angcwabe umsebenzi wakho:
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p1: Utsala i-slide se-Z88 yakho uze ume ecaleni kwesakhelo somnyango. Ngomngxuma wokujonga, isibane esitshajwayo siyadanyaza phezu kwe-windbreaker eluhlaza ye-SAPS emanzi te.
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p2: NguConstable Nandi—ukuphela kwesikolo esisandula ukungena emsebenzini esala ukutyikitya i-affidavit yobuxoki kaMokoena ngokuchasene nawe. Ubambe iimbambo zakhe zasekunxele, igazi elimnyama lisiza phakathi kweminwe yakhe, ephethe idokethi enzima yebrown kunye nefowuni eqhekekileyo phantsi kwengalo yakhe.
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p3: "Warrant..." uphefumla nzima, amehlo ejonge kwisithunzi sezinyuko. "Vula isango. Nceda. Ii-van ze-TRT zikaMokoena zisandula ukudlula kwindawo yeeteksi. Ukuba i-transponder yerediyo yam isasebenza, basemva kwam ngebhloko ezimbini."
pnode.scene_2_the_door.role: SAPS Amapolisa Kaloliwe Nomgwaqo Omkhulu (Owayesakuba nguMtsha Wakho)
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p1: Ucinezela itawuli ecocekileyo ecaleni kwakhe. Imbumbulu ye-9mm ikrwitshile iimbambo zakhe—inzulu ngokwaneleyo ukuba yopha rhoqo, kwaye iyingozi kakhulu ukuba ingathungwa kwisibhedlele sikarhulumente apho ababhalana bamapolisa babhala wonke umntu odutyulweyo.
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p2: UNandi uphosa iDokethi #409 kunye nefowuni egcwele igazi ezandleni zakho. "Siphendule ekuphangweni kwe-Cash-in-Transit kwindlela ye-N2 esezantsi phakathi kobusuku. I-van ye-G4S iqhushumbiswe nge-C4, Warrant. Kodwa bekungekho mali ngaphakathi."
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p3: Uginya nzima, engcangcazela. "Bekukho umphicothi-zincwadi kamasipala ofileyo eboshwe ngezandla kwiikheji zomgangatho, kunye nale ncwadi. Izigidi ezine zamakhulu amaRandi kwiithenda zokungxamiseka zeetankha zamanzi ezihanjiswe ngeofisi kaCeba Ma-Sibi ngqo kwiindawo zokugcina iimpahla zasezibukweni zikaZuko Ndlovu. Xa umlingane wam ezama ukuyibhalisa, uBrigadier Mokoena ufike ngebakkie ye-TRT engabhalwanga... waza wamdubula esifubeni."
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p1: UNandi uwa phantsi kwisofa yakho ngelixa ukusa okungwevu kwesixeko kungena ngeefestile. Ngaphandle, iiteksi ziqala ukukhala iimpondo zazo e-Queen Street.
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p2: Uneengxaki ezimbini ezikubetha ngaphakathi: Inxeba likaNandi elidutyulwe ngompu liza kubola kwiintsuku ezine ngaphandle kokuba uhlawule ugqirha ongabhaliswanga (R1,500), kwaye amaqela e-TRT kaBrigadier Mokoena ahlola isithili ngesithili.
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p3: Ezandleni zakho kukho ubungqina obudibanisa i-City Hall, i-SAPS Organized Crime, kunye ne-Abasanta Cartel. Iidayisi zakho zemihla ngemihla zikulungele etafileni.

tutorial.step1.bullet1: Cofa naliphi na idayisi kwitreyi esezantsi ukulibamba—yonke iSlot seZenzo ibonisa ngokukhawuleza iyonke yakho eguqulweyo (Luhlaza 6+, Otyheli 4–5, Bomvu 1–3).
tutorial.step1.bullet2: Awuqinisekanga ukuba wenze ntoni ngokulandelayo? Landela "UMcebisi weQhinga" kwiPhaneli yaseKhohlo okanye ujonge iibheji ezidanyazayo ze-"★ Kunconywe" kwii-node zemephu.
tutorial.step1.bullet3: Xa uphelelwe ngamadayisi osuku, cofa u-"Phelisa Umjikelo / Lala →" ukuze uqhubele phambili kusasa.
tutorial.step1.desc: Ngentsasa nganye yeSetyhula (Imini), umphenyi wakho uqengqa iidayisi ezi-3 ukuya kwezi-5 ezinamacala amathandathu ngokusekelwe kuKuzola kwangoku (80–100% = iidayisi ezi-5, 40–79% = iidayisi ezi-4, <40% = iidayisi ezi-3). Ukuzola bubuchule bakho bengqondo kunye nokumelana nomhlaba ongaphantsi waseDurban.
tutorial.step1.title: Inyathelo 1: Iidayisi Zentshukumo Zemihla Ngemihla & Ukuzola
tutorial.step1.zone: Amadayisi eZenzo zemihla ngemihla, Ukuzola noMcebisi weQhinga
tutorial.step2.bullet1: Ukuphonsa kokugqibela = Ubuso beDayisi + Isilungisi seStat + Ibhonasi ye-Stage 6 + Impahla.
tutorial.step2.bullet2: 6 okanye ngaphezulu (Luhlaza — Impumelelo eCocekileyo): Iqhubeleka iiWotshi zoPhando ngeziqwenga ezi-+2 okanye ihlawula iiRandi eziphezulu.
tutorial.step2.bullet3: 4 okanye 5 (Otyheli — Impumelelo esengozini): Iqhubeleka ngecandelo eli-+1, kodwa ilahlekisa ukuZola okuncinci.
tutorial.step2.bullet4: 1 ukuya ku-3 (Bomvu — Ukusilela / Isiphumo Esibi): Akukho nkqubela, ilahleko yoZolo, kwaye yongeza uBubushushu baseKhululweni.
tutorial.step2.desc: Bamba okanye ucofe idayisi kwindawo yakho esezantsi, uze ucofe Indawo Yentshukumo kuyo nayiphi na indawo yemephu evuliweyo. Ukuqengqeleka kusombululeka ngokucacileyo: Ixabiso Ledayisi + Isilungisi Sezibalo + Isilungisi Sokucima Kombane Kwinqanaba lesi-6 + Isohlwayo Sendawo Engafunwayo. Amanqanaba abonakala ngokucacileyo: 6+ Impumelelo Ecocekileyo, 4–5 Kubekwe Esiweni, 1–3 Ukusilela.
tutorial.step2.title: Inyathelo 2: Ukunika Iidayisi Kwiindawo Zentshukumo
tutorial.step2.zone: I-Slots zeZenzo ze-Node kunye nezilungisi ze-Stat
tutorial.step3.bullet1: Ivenkile yoMnyama (Phezulu kwi-HUD): Thenga uphuculo olusisigxina e-Golden Dragon okanye e-Point Road (+1 UCINGO, +1 ISITRATO, -50% uBuhlungu).
tutorial.step3.bullet2: Iifowuni zamaQhinga zamaQela (1/Ngosuku) (Iphaneli yaseKhohlo): Fikelela ku-+1/+2 Rep neqela ukuvula izakhono zasimahla zemihla ngemihla.
tutorial.step3.bullet3: Ukubuyiselwa kweSafehouse noLondolozo oluKhawulezayo: Sebenzisa iiRandi ekuPholeleni koBuhlungu (+25% uZolo), i-Shebeen, i-Diesel (R300), kunye nezifumbatho (R200).
tutorial.step3.desc: Amandla e-Eskom ajikeleza phakathi Kwamanqanaba 2 -> 4 -> 6 -> 2 ubusuku ngabunye. Ngexesha Lokucima Kombane Kwinqanaba lesi-6, iindawo zeseva zobuchwepheshe obuphezulu ziyavaleka ngaphandle kokuba uchithe i-R300 kwiDizili yeJeneretha Yokuxhasa, kodwa imisebenzi efihlakeleyo ePort naseZindaweni Zokuhlala ifumana iBhonasi yokuQengqa engu-+2 phantsi kobumnyama.
tutorial.step3.title: Inyathelo 3: Ukucima Kombane Okujikelezayo (Load Shedding)
tutorial.step3.zone: IiRandi (ZAR), Ivenkile yeZixhobo kunye neZibonelelo zamaQela
tutorial.step4.bullet1: Ukoyiswa / Ukubanjwa (Umdlalo Uphelile): Ukuba uMhlaseli ka-Brigadier Mokoena ufikelela ku-6/6, indlu ekhuselekileyo iyahlaselwa kwaye umdlalo uphela ngokubanjwa.
tutorial.step4.bullet2: Ukubulawa koMlinganiswa (UKonstebile uNandi): Ukuba "Ukopha kukaNandi" kufikelela ku-4/4 ngaphambi kokuba umzinzise, uKonstebile uNandi uyafa unaphakade (-30% uZolo).
tutorial.step4.bullet3: Ukuwa koZolo (0% uZolo): Ukufikelela ku-0% kubangela ukuwa kwengqondo okulahlekisa iDayisi eli-1 ngomso. Ukuhla kwe-Rep yeqela kuye ku--2 kubangela impindezelo yezixhobo.
tutorial.step4.desc: Iiwotshi ezijikelezayo ezinecandelo zibala ixesha leentlekele ezizayo (Ukutshayela kukaBrigadier Mokoena, Inxeba likaNandi, Izinkabi Hit Squads) kwaye zilandelela izinto ozifumanayo kwezobugcisa bokuphenya (Uhlolo lweDocket #409, Ukuqhekeza iFowuni, Uthotho lwezithuthi eBerth 14). Xa iiwotshi zophando zigcwele, kuvuleka iintlangano zokugqibela ezibalulekileyo.
tutorial.step4.title: Inyathelo 4: Iiwotshi Zesoyikiso & Zophando
tutorial.step4.zone: Iiwotshi zoSongo, uZolo kunye noBume boMlinganiswa
tutorial.step5.bullet1: Ukuvalwa kwe-Stage 6: Ii-server zase-City Hall nase-Golden Dragon zicima ngexesha le-Stage 6—ngaphandle kokuba uhlawula i-R300 ye-diesel yejenereyitha.
tutorial.step5.bullet2: Ibhonasi yoKhuselo ye-Stage 6: Ukungena kwi-Pier 2 Cold Storage kufumana ibhonasi ye-+2 ngethuba le-Stage 6 ngenxa yokucima kwezibane ze-harbour.
tutorial.step5.bullet3: Iizithintelo ze-SAPS: Ukuba ubushushu bufikelela ku-4+, iindlela zedolophu ziyavalwa, zixabisa i-R200 okanye iDayisi eli-1 ukuwela ngaphandle kokuba une-Scanner ye-SAPS.
tutorial.step5.desc: Ubunzima obuphezulu bePrecinct Heat okanye iThreat levels zibangela ukuba kubekho iirodibhlogi zeSAPS ezixhobileyo phakathi kweesektha. Ukuwela kuzo kutshisa i-1 Die okanye i-R200 kwiirhwaphilizo 'zecold drink' ngaphandle kokuba uneskana seSAPS esikopiweyo. Fumana i-Faction Rep elungileyo ukuze uvule izakhono zobuchule ezi-1 ngosuku ezifana neGrid Manipulation kunye neBlue-Light Escorts.
tutorial.step5.title: Inyathelo lesi-5: Izithintelo zeendlela kunye neengenelo zamaqela
tutorial.step6.bullet1: Ukuphumelela Isenzo 1 noKungena kwiSenzo 2: Fumana imikhondo emi-2 ephambili ukuqala i-Berth 14 Finale, uze ucofe "Qhubeka uye kwiSenzo 2: I-Bluff Refinery →".
tutorial.step6.bullet2: Ukuphumelela Isenzo 2: Cazulula imbonakalo yombhobho we-Island View kunye nophicotho lwe-petrochemical ukuqala uMgwebo wePalamente.
tutorial.step6.bullet3: UMdlalo oMtsha+ kunye neRejista ye-Fixer: Emva koloyiso, khangela iBanga lakho le-Fixer kwi-Registry yaseThekwini, uqokelele iiBheji ezi-6, uze uqale uMdlalo oMtsha+ ukugcina zonke izixhobo + R1,000!
tutorial.step6.desc: Thetha nabalungisi balapha kunye nabaphathi bamaqela kwindawo nganye ukuze uphenye imikhondo, unikezele ngobungqina bezobugcisa bokuphenya, kwaye ufune iinkonzo zexesha elinye. Cofa 'B' okanye ucofe 'BOARD' nangaliphi na ixesha ukuze uhlole ibhodi yakho yobuqhetseba yentambo ebomvu, ulandelela umkhondo wemali ukusuka kwiCity Hall ukuya eBerth 14.
tutorial.step6.title: Inyathelo lesi-6: Abaqhagamshelani, Ubungqina kunye neBhodi yeNtambo eBomvu
tutorial.step6.zone: Isenzo 1 → Isenzo 2, UVimba weZiphelo noMdlalo oMtsha+
